units.source_text: 我甚至覺得自己揹負著十大災禍，

en.t: I even felt as though I was carrying ten great calamities on my back,

units.source_text: 若將其中的一個交給旁人來揹負，恐怕都會將其置於死地吧。

en.t: and that if I handed even one of them to someone else to bear, it would probably be enough to kill them.
In short, I could not understand it.

units.source_text: 旁人痛苦的性質與程度，都是我永遠捉摸不透的。

en.t: The nature and degree of other people's suffering were things I could never grasp.

units.source_text: 實際的痛苦，僅靠吃飯就能解決的痛苦，

en.t: Actual suffering, the kind of suffering that could be solved simply by eating,

units.source_text: 也許才是最慘烈的痛苦，是足以將我的十大災禍吹散的、極度悽慘的阿鼻地獄[1]吧。

en.t: might in fact be the most terrible suffering of all, an utterly wretched Avici hell [1] powerful enough to blow away my ten calamities.

units.source_text: 可我不明白是否真的如此，他們竟然不去自殺，不去發瘋，

en.t: But I did not know whether that was really so; after all, they did not kill themselves or go mad,

units.source_text: 談論政治又不絕望，不屈不撓地與生活持續搏鬥，不是也不痛苦嗎？

en.t: they talked about politics without despairing, and kept struggling stubbornly through life. Did that not mean they were not suffering either?

units.source_text: 他們變成徹底的利己主義者，並視其為理所當然，不是也從沒懷疑過自己嗎？

en.t: They became thoroughgoing egoists and took it as perfectly natural; had they never once doubted themselves either?
